ads.title: The roll-on that helped my mom sleep.
ads.body:
Her mother couldn't sleep through her migraines. One application on the temples.
Within hours, she was asleep — and the pain didn't come back.

Shunyata Migraine Relief Roll-On is a polyherbal aromatherapy formula — 12 botanical
extracts including peppermint, eucalyptus, lavender, and chamomile — that supports comfort
during severe migraine episodes.

Cooling on contact. Calming on the senses. Quietly effective.

For the parent you can't watch struggle anymore. 100% natural.

ads.title: Newborn Sleep Help.
ads.body:
You’ve been told sleepless nights are just part of it.
But what if they didn’t have to be?

I’m Cara. Neonatal nurse. Mom. Sleep expert. I created a class to help babies and parents rest—starting from the very first weeks.
Learn how to calm your fussy baby, understand their cues, and set your nights up for success.
